p.write_text('''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The solid separator divides the two noisy panels.
    sep = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
        cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
        common = set(ca) & set(cb)
        color = max(common, key=lambda x: min(ca[x], cb[x])) if common else 0
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
    sep = next((c for c in range(w) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1), None)
    a = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    b = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row); cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
    common = set(ca) & set(cb)
    color = max(common, key=lambda x: min(ca[x], cb[x])) if common else 0
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color for c in range(min(len(a[r]),len(b[r])))] for r in range(h)]
''')
